records.subject: Labour, Employment, Wages and Productivity
records.title: Number Of Active Employers, Annual
records.footnote: Prior to 1Q 2025, active employers refer to employers who had paid Central Provident Fund contribution for the previous month.  With effect from 1Q 2025, active employers refer to registered employers (identified by their Unique Entity Number) who are liable to pay CPF contributions for the current month.
